entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight on her last mission, who declines Teferi's proposal.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Companion who meets with Teferi and Jhoira.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Place where Jhoira drops off refugees.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: Place Jhoira decides to return to.

events.summary: On her last mission as captain of the Weatherlight, Jhoira takes refugees from Serra's Realm to Zhalfir.
events.quote: she goes to Zhalfir to drop off some of the refugees from Serra's Realm

events.summary: Jhoira and Karn meet with Teferi and reminisce.
events.quote: they reminisce about their adventures together

events.summary: Teferi proposes to Jhoira; she turns him down to live her own life and return to Shiv.
